question: Must all applications of the twelve-syllable mantra be performed in that context?
premises: The applications pertain to a twelve-syllable mantra.
All those applications are included without exception.
The instruction requires causing them to be performed there.
inference: Therefore, every application of the twelve-syllable mantra must be carried out in that context.
uncertainties: The specific referent of tatra depends on the preceding ritual context.
plain_english: And there one should have all those applications of the twelve-syllable mantra performed.
